verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਜੈਮਨਿ ਰਿਖੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਜੁਜਰ ਵੇਦਿ ਮਥਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: fir jaiman rikh boliaa jujar vedh math kathaa sunaavai|

en.bdb: Pondering deeply over the Yajurveda, rishi Jaimini putforth his postulates.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਤੇ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਧਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: karamaa ute nibaRai dhehee madh kare so paavai|

en.bdb: Ultimate decision will be arrived at according to the actions performed through the body which will reap whatever it has sowed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥਾਪਸਿ ਕਰਮ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਮ ਵਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: thaapas karam sa(n)saar vich karam vaas kar aavai jaavai|

en.bdb: He established the theory of karma and explained transmigration as controlled by karma.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sahasaa manahu na chukiee karamaa(n) a(n)dhar bharam bhulaavai|

en.bdb: Because of its fallacy of ad-infinitum, the doubts are cleared and the jiv goes on wandering in the labyrinth of karmas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਇਕੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: karam varatan jagat kee iko maiaa braham kahaavai|

en.bdb: Karma is a practical aspect of the world and the maya and the Brahm are identical.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੁਜਰਿ ਵੇਦਿ ਕੋ ਮਥਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jujar vedh ko mathan kar tat braham vich bharam milaavai|

en.bdb: This school of thought (Shastra) while stirring the ingredients of Yajurveda, mixes delusions with the supreme reality the Brahm,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਮ ਬੰਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: karam dhiraRai jagat vich karam ba(n)dh kar aavai jaavai|

en.bdb: And establishes strongly the ritualism which further accepts coming in and going from the world as the result of the karma bondage.
Without the true Guru, the doubts cannot be dispelled away.
